evaluation_scope.limitations: Offline engineering checks only; business impact, fairness and promotion outcomes must be validated on governed real-world data before production use.

interpretation.baseline: The baseline picks the highest-ranked available activity touching the employee's lowest absolute target-grade skill.
interpretation.coverage: Share of eligible employees receiving at least one next step.
interpretation.explanation_completeness: Every recommendation exposes all four factors and score components.
interpretation.positive_counterfactual: Projected readiness is higher than current readiness.
interpretation.repeatability: Two fresh engines return the same ordered event IDs and scores.
interpretation.role_eligibility: Every recommendation satisfies the event audience rule.
